description: Constraints every xstack production build must meet, whatever the country. Themes are the ones in references/service-standard-baseline.md.

constraints.title: No secrets in source
constraints.fix: Remove the value. Read it from the environment or the platform's secret store, and rotate it if it was ever real.

constraints.title: No inline event handlers
constraints.fix: Move the behaviour to a linked script and use addEventListener, so a strict Content-Security-Policy can stay on.

constraints.title: No inline scripts
constraints.fix: Link the script with src. A strict Content-Security-Policy blocks inline script.

constraints.title: Forms that send files or passwords use POST
constraints.fix: Set method="post" on the form (and enctype="multipart/form-data" for uploads). GET puts the data in the URL, in logs and in history.

constraints.title: No secrets leaked in git history or working tree (gitleaks)
constraints.fix: Remove and rotate whatever gitleaks reports.

constraints.title: No known high or critical vulnerabilities in dependencies
constraints.fix: Upgrade or replace the dependency. If there is no fix yet, a human records a waiver with an expiry date.

constraints.title: Dependencies are pinned by a lockfile
constraints.fix: Run the package manager's install and commit the lockfile.

constraints.title: Every page declares its language, has a title and a main landmark
constraints.fix: Add the missing element. Screen readers need all four.

constraints.title: Every image has an alt attribute
constraints.fix: Add alt text, or alt="" if the image is decoration.

constraints.title: Every internal link and form action goes somewhere
constraints.fix: Build the page, or remove the link until it exists. A dead link in a government service is a dead end for a citizen.

constraints.title: Styles are linked, not inlined
constraints.fix: Move the rules to the linked stylesheet. Use the design system's own classes first.

constraints.title: No prototype chrome in production
constraints.fix: Strip the assumptions panel, banner and mock-data markers. Citizens must never see invented data presented as real.
